AP 12 Nov Nasser Hospital strike and older Reuters/AP casualty stories returned by fresh searches were historical, not newly surfaced separate events.

limitations: WHO regional site remained HTTP 502. Accessible WHO global and OCHA pages supplied useful alternate coverage; degraded, not failed. This is an existing restriction rather than a new material outage.
OCHA 16 Nov access-and-movement map remains listed; earlier watches documented underlying oversized PDF retrieval and this run did not infer map-only crossing changes.
Search results were often stale despite a two-day recency constraint. Absence of verified findings does not prove absence of events or production ingestion.
coverage_notes.overall: No new or previously uncaptured qualifying Gaza civilian/humanitarian development verified after 17:44:22.831 PST cutoff. Prior WHO regional coverage gap persists, with official fallback accessible. No new material degradation observed.
